propertySets.name: Pset_SensorTypeHeatSensor
propertySets.definition: A device that senses or detects heat. HISTORY: In IFC4, incorporates Fire Sensor. HeatSensorSetPoint changed to SetPointTemperature

properties.name: CoverageArea
properties.definition:
The area that is covered by the object.

Floor area (typically measured as a circle whose center is at the location of the sensor).

properties.name: SetPointTemperature
properties.definition: The temperature value to be sensed. Use IfcPropertyBoundedValue.SetPointValue to set the set point value.

properties.name: RateOfTemperatureRise
properties.definition: The rate of temperature rise that is to be sensed as being hazardous.
